addRecipients(address[],uint256[],uint25.details: Owner of the vesting escrow needs to approve tokens to this contract      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

params._amounts: An array of amounts to be vested by the corresponding recipient addresses
params._cliffDurations: An array of cliff durations of the vesting schedule for the corresponding recipient addresses
params._endTimes: An array of endTimes of the vesting schedule for the corresponding recipient addresses
params._startTimes: An array of startTimes of the vesting schedule for the corresponding recipient addresses
params._totalAmount: Total sum of the amounts in the _amounts array

batchTotalLockedOf(address[]).details: Reverts if any of the recipients is terminated.

params._recipients: An array of non-terminated recipient addresses.

returns.totalAmount: Total locked (non-vested) tokens for multiple non-terminated recipient addresses.

batchTotalVestedOf(address[]).details: Reverts if any of the recipients is terminated.

params._recipients: An array of non-terminated recipient addresses.

returns.totalAmount: total vested tokens for all _recipients passed.

canClaim(address).details: Reverts if the recipient is a zero address.

returns._0: bool representing if the recipient can successfully invoke claim.

claim(uint256).details: Claim a specific amount of tokens.      Will revert if amount parameter is greater than the claimable amount      of tokens for the recipient at the time of function invocation.      Can be invoked by any non-terminated recipient.

params.amount: The amount of tokens recipient wants to claim.

claimStartTimeFor(address).details: Reverts if the recipient is a zero address.

returns._0: Returns the time after (inclusive) which recipient can successfully invoke claim.

claimableAmountFor(address).details: Reverts if the recipient is terminated.

returns._0: Amount of tokens that can be claimed by a recipient at the current timestamp.

inCaseAssetGetStuck(address,address).details: It is assumed that the "to" address is NOT malicious      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Reverts if the asset address is a zero address or the token address.      Reverts if the to address is a zero address.

params.asset: Address of the ERC20 asset to be rescued
params.to: Address to which all ERC20 asset amount will be transferred

returns.rescued: Total amount of asset transferred to the SAFE_ADDRESS.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pauseRecipient(address).details: This freezes the vesting schedule for the paused recipient.      Recipient will NOT be able to claim until unpaused.      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

params.recipient: The recipient address for which vesting will be paused.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

seizeLockedTokens(address[]).details: It is assumed that the SAFE_ADDRESS is NOT malicious      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Reverts if any of the recipients is terminated.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is terminated.

params._recipients: An array of non-terminated recipient addresses.

returns.totalSeized: Total tokens seized from the recipients.

terminateRecipient(address).details: This terminates the vesting schedule for the recipient forever.      Recipient will NOT be able to claim.      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

params.recipient: The recipient address for which vesting will be terminated.

terminateVestingEscrow().details: All the vesting states will be freezed, recipients can still claim their vested tokens.      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

totalLockedOf(address).details: Reverts if any of the recipients is terminated.

returns._0: Total locked tokens of a specific recipient.

totalVestedOf(address).details: Reverts if the recipient is terminated.

returns._0: Total vested tokens for the recipient address.

transferDust().details: It is assumed that the SAFE_ADDRESS is NOT malicious.      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.

returns._0: Amount of dust to the SAFE_ADDRESS.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unPauseRecipient(address).details: This unfreezes the vesting schedule for the paused recipient. Recipient will be able to claim.      In order to keep vestingPerSec for the recipient a constant, cliffDuration and endTime for the      recipient are shifted by the pause duration so that the recipient resumes with the same state      at the time it was paused.      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

params.recipient: The recipient address for which vesting will be unpaused.

updateSafeAddress(address).details: It is assumed that the SAFE_ADDRESS is NOT malicious      Only owner of the vesting escrow can invoke this function.      Can only be invoked if the escrow is NOT terminated.

params.safeAddress: An address where all the tokens are transferred in case of a (recipient/escrow) termination

batchTotalLockedOf(address[]).notice: Get total locked (non-vested) tokens for multiple non-terminated recipient addresses.

batchTotalVestedOf(address[]).notice: Get total vested tokens for multiple recipients.

canClaim(address).notice: Check if a recipient address can successfully invoke claim.

claim(uint256).notice: Claim a specific amount of tokens.

claimStartTimeFor(address).notice: Check the time after (inclusive) which recipient can successfully invoke claim.

claimableAmountFor(address).notice: Get amount of tokens that can be claimed by a recipient at the current timestamp.

inCaseAssetGetStuck(address,address).notice: Allows owner to transfer the ERC20 assets (other than token) to the "to" address in case of any emergency

seizeLockedTokens(address[]).notice: Transfers the locked (non-vested) tokens of the passed recipients to the SAFE_ADDRESS

totalLockedOf(address).notice: Get total locked tokens of a specific recipient.

totalVestedOf(address).notice: Get total vested tokens of a specific recipient.

transferDust().notice: Transfers the dust to the SAFE_ADDRESS.
